messages:
Lina Park: Quick design review idea  a compact history "breadcrumbs" for Deployments + rethink revert UX. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (frame: history-crumbs) :eyes:

Samir Patel: Nice visual. Accessibility Q: how do keyboard users traverse crumbs without making Tab huge?

Aria Gomez: Arrow-key nav (left/right) on the crumb list is the usual pattern. Use role=listbox+option or a roledescription. Announce like: "Version 2023-11-02, canary 10%". Use aria-live for state changes only.

Jayden Wu: Also: collapse low-traffic variants behind a "+N" chip for A/B groups with many variants. Hover previews a tiny tooltip; click/enter opens diff.

Kevin O'Neill: Microcopy: change "Promote" -> "Roll forward" and "Publish" -> "Finalize". "Promote" confuses some users.

Lina Park: For revert flow: inline undo toast for quick mistakes (5s) + an explicit "Revert to snapshot" modal for full rollbacks. Keeps default fast but safe.

Samir Patel: Toast should be non-focus-stealing and use polite aria-live: "Deployment reverted. Undo available."

Aria Gomez: SR helper string proposal: "Deployment history. Use left/right arrows to navigate versions. Press Enter for details." Keep it short.

Jayden Wu: Interaction rule: no auto-opening diffs on hover. Hover shows summary: author, short commit, traffic %. Tooltip delay 300ms.

Lina Park: Add short diff summary in crumb label: e.g., "+2 prompts, -1 param" so folks scan quickly.

Kevin O'Neill: Color nits: status pills need icons or shapes for colorblind users and higher contrast. Add a left indicator glyph + text label.

ux-bot: history-crumbs updated  preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood/history-crumbs (build 701) :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: Also add a small "Go to latest" button at start of crumbs with aria-label so keyboard users can jump.

Aria Gomez: Ensure focus order: go-to-latest -> crumbs -> action buttons, and SR announces current selection.

Lina Park: Next steps: Jayden  collapse chip + tooltip delay. Aria  final SR copy and aria attrs. Kevin  update CTAs and icons. Samir  prototype arrow keys/tab. I'll update Figma then loop back. :thumbsup:

Jayden Wu: On it.

Aria Gomez: Will post SR strings by EOD.

Kevin O'Neill: Mocking icons now.

Lina Park: Thanks team, prefer async unless blockers.
